info.name: Retrieve forecasted signals for a specific site

params.name: start
params.description:
Start of window (ISO 8601). Must be a perfect quarter hour without seconds or milliseconds precision.

**Note**: To avoid timezone issues, we perform an additional check for the presence of timezone information. You should always include either UTC with `Z`, or an offset like `+01:00`.

params.name: amount
params.description: The number of forecast data points to retrieve.

params.name: granularity
params.description: The granularity to fetch the forecast for, i.e. the time length of each element. Only 15-minute granularity is supported. The expected format is ISO8601.
